stock_impact.model: sector impact × automatic NSE crude sensitivity
stock_impact.methodology: The NSE_LIST universe is scanned automatically. Because the current NSE sheet has blank Sector/Industry fields, high-confidence symbol rules and company-name industry keywords are used. Impact is a reference score, not an expected stock return or trading recommendation.
stock_impact.classification_source: NSE_LIST symbol + company name + sector/industry when available
